note: THE CHECKER RECOVERS ABOUT A QUARTER OF THE CYNGHANEDD THAT IS THERE. Nothing was tuned; the shortfall is the finding. Three mechanical causes, each with a minimal repro. DEFECT 1, INTERNAL APOSTROPHE: units() strips only leading/trailing quotes, so the elisions Welsh uses constantly are out of inventory — units("a'i") is None, units("ai") is ['a','i']; units("sy'n") is None, units("syn") is ['s','y','n']. skeleton() then returns None and the WHOLE LINE is 'unreadable' before any rule runs. 31.0% of the Alun corpus contains one. DEFECT 2, PRINTED COMMAS READ AS CAESURAS: cynghanedd() splits on [,/|], so ordinary verse punctuation is taken for the gwant and a 3-comma line is forced down the sain path — 'Eto, Aled, atolwg' is REFUSED ('sain needs rhyme AND alliteration'), while 'Eto Aled | atolwg' returns croes on skeleton ['t']. DEFECT 3, THE GWANT IS PRINTED AS '--' AND '--' IS NOT IN THE SPLIT SET: this transcription does mark the englyn gwant, with a dash, e.g. 'Bryd a chorff yn ddiorffwys,--'; the comma split leaves a half of '--' whose words all strip to empty, so skeleton() returns None and the line is 'unreadable'. 14.6% of lines carry a '--'. Permissive: 737 quatrain segments, of which 82 (11%) show exact ABAB — 11% is far above chance and matches Skeat's fn.[431]. THREE REAL QUATRAINS, rime marked (A/B = end-rime class): (1) 'Chandrawasi burong sakti,' A(-i) / 'Sangat berkurong didalam awan.' B(-an) / 'Gonda gulana didalam hati,' A(-i) / 'Sahari tidak memandang tuan.' B(-an) — Skeat labels this 'a common pantun, a kind of erotic stanza'; pembayang = a magic bird shut in the clouds, maksud = my heart is troubled a day without seeing you. (2) 'Bukan gantang gantang lada,' A(-a) / 'Gantang berisi hampa padi,' B(-i) / 'Bukan-nya datang datang sahaja,' A(-a) / 'Besar maksud kahandak hati.' B(-i) — the quatrain names its own maksud. ORTHOGRAPHY — PRE-1972, British-Malayan (Straits) Rumi, NOT Dutch and NOT Ejaan Rumi Baharu. A phonology module must accept: 'ch' for modern 'c' (chinchang, berchuchok, kuching); final '-o-' for modern '-u-' (burong=burung, tumboh=tumbuh, jantong=jantung, dudok=duduk, jatoh=jatuh, pechah=pecah); 'ei' for modern 'ai' (gulei=gulai); 'ka-' for 'ke-' (kapada, ka-tiga, ka-dalam); 'sa-' for 'se-' (sa-batang, sa'ekor); hyphenated di- and -nya (di-bawa, di-jeput, maka-nya, rupa-nya); 'angkau' for 'engkau'; apostrophe for hamzah/ain (do'a, pinta', ta'tabek, `adat). Rime detection is unaffected (the -o/-u and ch/c swaps are consistent across the rime), but any lexicon lookup must normalise first. note: THE 10.3%/26.1% UNDER-DETECTION WAS THREE MECHANICAL DEFECTS PLUS ONE STATISTICAL ONE. So the original 26.1% was indistinguishable from the null. Report the excess over the shuffled null, never the raw searched rate.
